title: Health Insurance Underwriting and the Heterogeneous Effects of the Affordable Care Act
title_zh: 健康保险核保与《平价医疗法案》的异质性效应
title_primary: 健康保险核保与《平价医疗法案》的异质性效应
title_secondary: Health Insurance Underwriting and the Heterogeneous Effects of the Affordable Care Act
authors: Pietro Tebaldi, Andrea Scalenghe, Joseph Orsini
official: 官方在线 2026-09-03 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: The Affordable Care Act, the largest US welfare reform since 1965, banned health insurance underwriting and rejections based on pre-existing conditions and introduced large premium subsidies for low- to middle-income individuals. Yet how many people the ban made better off, and how its effects varied by health risk, remain unknown—because data on who was rejected before the reform have been lacking. Using a proprietary dataset of pre-ACA insurance applications and underwriting decisions, we document, model, and estimate the reform's heterogeneous effects by age, income, and health risk. We find its benefits were concentrated among low-income, high-risk, or over-50 individuals.

title: Welfare Effects of Gas Price Fluctuations
title_zh: 天然气价格波动的福利效应
title_primary: 天然气价格波动的福利效应
title_secondary: Welfare Effects of Gas Price Fluctuations
authors: Florian Kuhn, Matthias Kehrig, Nicolas L. Ziebarth
official: 官方在线 2025-03-06 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: The share of gasoline consumption in household expenditures decreases with income, gasoline demand being least elastic for low-income households. Based on this empirical evidence for non-homotheticities, we develop a quantitative heterogeneous-agent general equilibrium model to quantify the distributional consequences of oil price shocks. Although oil price shocks have small aggregate effects, they hurt low-income households considerably with costs to lifetime utility two to three times larger for those in the bottom decile of income relative to those in the top decile. Additionally, the 2014/15 oil glut depressed gasoline prices, which delivered comparable welfare benefits to the 2018 tax cuts.
abstract_zh: 汽油消费在家庭支出中的份额随收入增加而下降，低收入家庭的汽油需求弹性最小。基于这一非齐次性经验证据，我们构建了一个定量异质性主体一般均衡模型，以量化油价冲击的分配效应。尽管油价冲击对总体经济影响较小，但对低收入家庭造成显著损害，其终身效用成本相对于收入最高十分位家庭高出两到三倍。此外，2014/15年石油供应过剩压低了汽油价格，其带来的福利收益与2018年减税政策相当。

title: International Cocoa Trading Arrangements Between Industrialised and Developing Countries 1951–1999: A Structural Gravity Analysis
title_zh: 工业化国家与发展中国家之间的国际可可贸易安排（1951—1999年）：结构引力分析
title_primary: 工业化国家与发展中国家之间的国际可可贸易安排（1951—1999年）：结构引力分析
title_secondary: International Cocoa Trading Arrangements Between Industrialised and Developing Countries 1951–1999: A Structural Gravity Analysis
authors: John Brown, Xenia Matschke, Juan René Rojas Rodríguez
official: 官方在线 2026-09-03 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Using a state‐of‐the‐art structural gravity model, we investigate the impact of various (post‐)colonial cocoa trading arrangements on the cocoa trade between developing cocoa producer countries and rich industrial cocoa consumer nations in the time period 1951–1999. We find that in particular the trading arrangements of the European (Economic) Community (EEC/EC), such as the Association, Yaoundé and Lomé Agreements, as well as the UNCTAD International Cocoa Agreement, had a measurable positive impact on cocoa trade flows, in contrast to the British Commonwealth partnership or the GATT Generalised System of Preferences. In particular, the Yaoundé Agreement not only increased the trade between other EEC/EC members and the signatory cocoa producers, but also strengthened the trading relationship between the former coloniser countries and their cocoa producing former colonies, in fact more than offsetting the negative effect of independence.
abstract_zh: 利用最先进的结构引力模型，我们研究了1951年至1999年间各种（后）殖民时期可可贸易安排对发展中国家可可生产国与富裕工业可可消费国之间可可贸易的影响。我们发现，尤其是欧洲（经济）共同体（EEC/EC）的贸易安排，如联系协定、雅温得协定和洛美协定，以及联合国贸发会议的国际可可协定，对可可贸易流产生了显著的正面影响，这与英联邦伙伴关系或关贸总协定普遍优惠制形成对比。特别是雅温得协定，不仅促进了其他EEC/EC成员国与签署国可可生产国之间的贸易，还加强了前殖民国家与其可可生产前殖民地之间的贸易关系，实际上其正面效应超过了独立带来的负面影响。

title: Parental Leave from the Firm's Perspective
title_zh: 企业视角下的育儿假研究
title_primary: 企业视角下的育儿假研究
title_secondary: Parental Leave from the Firm's Perspective
authors: Gozde Corekcioglu, Marco Francesconi, Astrid Kunze
official: 官方在线 2025-05-21 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This study investigates the firm’s response to parental leave induced worker absence. Combining a 20-week maternal leave expansion in Norway and detailed matched employer-employee data between 1983 and 2013, we identify the causal impact of absence on outcomes using a shift-share design. Employers with greater exposure to absence hire more women aged 40 or less and face more employment turnover. These adjustments do not affect profits, but lead to greater investments and sales and to a lower value added and a lower wage bill. One important channel behind such changes is a significant growth of young female part-time employment.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了企业对产假引发的员工缺勤的应对措施。结合挪威20周产假延长政策及1983年至2013年间详细的匹配雇主-雇员数据，我们采用份额转移设计识别了缺勤对结果的因果影响。缺勤暴露程度较高的雇主会雇佣更多40岁及以下的女性，并面临更高的员工流动率。这些调整不影响利润，但导致投资和销售额增加，同时附加值及工资总额下降。这一变化背后的一个重要渠道是年轻女性兼职就业的显著增长。

title: Intergenerational Transmission of Victimization
title_zh: 受害的代际传递
title_primary: 受害的代际传递
title_secondary: Intergenerational Transmission of Victimization
authors: Sonia Bhalotra, Meltem Daysal, Mathias Fjællegaard Jensen, Thomas H. Jørgensen, Sébastien Montpetit
official: 官方在线 2026-05-29 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Using four decades of Danish administrative data, we estimate the intergenerational transmission of violent crime victimization. Sons are twice as likely, and daughters three times as likely, to be victimized if a parent was victimized, with stronger associations if the mother was the victim. Controlling for cohort, municipality, socioeconomic factors, parental cohabitation, and parental offending explains about 60% of this correlation. The link is weaker in higher‑income families; it persists for sons, but is driven to zero for daughters. Further, children of victimized parents experience lower absolute income mobility, comparable to the Black‑White difference for men in the United States.
abstract_zh: 利用四十年丹麦行政数据，我们估算了暴力犯罪受害的代际传递效应。若父母曾受害，儿子受害可能性为两倍，女儿则为三倍，且母亲受害时关联更强。控制队列、市镇、社会经济因素、父母同居状况及父母犯罪后，该相关性约60%得到解释。在高收入家庭中，此关联较弱；对儿子持续存在，但对女儿则降至零。此外，受害父母的子女绝对收入流动性较低，其程度堪比美国男性中黑人与白人的差异。

title: Disruption in the Classroom: Experimental Evidence from Ecuador
title_zh: 课堂中的干扰：来自厄瓜多尔的实验证据
title_primary: 课堂中的干扰：来自厄瓜多尔的实验证据
title_secondary: Disruption in the Classroom: Experimental Evidence from Ecuador
authors: Carneiro, Pedro, Cruz-Aguayo, Yyannu, Salvati, Francesca, Schady, Norbert
official: 来源期次 American Economic Journal: Applied Economics · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: We study how poorly-behaved children affect learning and other outcomes of their peers using data from a unique experiment in Ecuador. Within each school, students were randomly assigned to classrooms in every grade for seven consecutive grades, between kindergarten and 6th grade. Children with persistent behavioral problems lower the math and language achievement of their classmates. The more poorly-behaved children there are in a class, the larger is the negative effect on the achievement of their classmates. These negative impacts are larger for younger children, and they persist for at least two years after exposure to a poorly-behaved peer.
abstract_zh: 我们利用厄瓜多尔一项独特实验的数据，研究了行为不良儿童如何影响其同伴的学习及其他成果。在每所学校内，从幼儿园至六年级连续七个年级，学生被随机分配到各年级的教室中。具有持续行为问题的儿童会降低同班同学的数学和语言成绩。班级中行为不良儿童的数量越多，对同班同学成绩的负面影响就越大。这些负面影响对年龄较小的儿童更为显著，并且在接触行为不良同伴后至少持续两年。

title: Killer Acquisitions and Beyond: Policy Effects on Innovation Strategies
title_zh: 杀手收购及其超越：政策对创新战略的影响
title_primary: 杀手收购及其超越：政策对创新战略的影响
title_secondary: Killer Acquisitions and Beyond: Policy Effects on Innovation Strategies
authors: Igor Letina, A. Schmutzler, Regina Seibel
official: 聚合元数据日期 2020-01-01 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This article provides a theory of strategic innovation project choice by incumbents and start‐ups which serves as a foundation for the analysis of acquisition policy. We show that, in spite of countervailing incentives on incumbents and entrants, prohibiting acquisitions has a weakly negative overall innovation effect. We provide conditions determining the size of the effect and conditions under which it is zero. We further analyze the effects of less restrictive policies, including merger remedies and the tax treatment of acquisitions and initial public offerings. Such interventions tend to prevent acquisitions only if the entrant has sufficiently high stand‐alone profits.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种关于在位企业与初创企业战略性创新项目选择的理论，为收购政策分析奠定基础。我们证明，尽管在位企业与新进入者存在相互抵消的激励，禁止收购对整体创新具有弱负效应。我们提供了决定该效应大小的条件，以及该效应为零的条件。我们进一步分析了限制性较弱政策的影响，包括并购补救措施以及收购和首次公开募股的税收处理。此类干预措施通常仅在进入者具有足够高的独立利润时，才会阻止收购发生。

title: Fire Sale Risk and Credit
title_zh: 火灾抛售风险与信贷
title_primary: 火灾抛售风险与信贷
title_secondary: Fire Sale Risk and Credit
authors: D. Bongaerts, Francesco Mazzola, W. Wagner
official: 聚合元数据日期 2021-01-01 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper examines whether the risk of a future collateral fire sale affects lending decisions. We study US mortgage applications and exploit exogenous variation in foreclosure frictions for identification. We find lenders to be less likely to approve mortgages when anticipated losses due to uncoordinated collateral liquidations are high, and when there is elevated risk of joint collateral liquidation. These results suggest that fire-sale risk has implications for credit allocation, and that lenders' collective origination decisions mitigate fire sale risk ex-post. However, we also find the effects to be significantly weaker outside periods in which fire sales are salient.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了未来抵押品抛售风险是否影响贷款决策。我们利用美国抵押贷款申请数据，并借助止赎摩擦的外生变化进行识别。研究发现，当因不协调的抵押品清算导致的预期损失较高，以及联合抵押品清算风险上升时，贷款机构批准抵押贷款的可能性降低。这些结果表明，抛售风险对信贷配置具有影响，且贷款机构的集体放贷决策在事后缓解了抛售风险。然而，我们也发现，在抛售现象不显著的时期，这些效应明显减弱。

title: Making AI Tutoring Productive: Evidence from a Mastery-Based Math Practice Experiment
title_zh: 让AI辅导更具成效：基于精熟学习的数学练习实验证据
title_primary: 让AI辅导更具成效：基于精熟学习的数学练习实验证据
title_secondary: Making AI Tutoring Productive: Evidence from a Mastery-Based Math Practice Experiment
authors: Philip Oreopoulos, Michael Liut, Alp Sungu, Nina Low
official: 官方在线 2026-08-17 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can make tutoring more scalable, but only if students use them to reason through mistakes rather than avoid effort. We study this question in a randomized field experiment with more than 6, 000 middle-school students in Hamilton County Schools using NUMI, a research-based computer-assisted learning (CAL) platform. Students were randomized to AI versus CAL-only support, mastery versus non-mastery progression, and one of two math topics. One week later, they completed a delayed assessment covering practiced and unpracticed material. AI students progressed more slowly and attempted fewer questions, but answered more accurately conditional on reaching an attempt. The clearest mechanism appeared after mistakes: AI improved next-attempt correctness and reduced attempts needed to return to a correct answer, while increasing time spent on each question receiving structured support. Mastery increased three-correct-in-a-row attainment but did not by itself improve delayed learning. The most encouraging delayed-test evidence appears when AI is embedded in the mastery workflow, with marginally significant gains concentrated on practiced Exercise 1 material. The results suggest that LLM tutoring can add value over standard CAL, but its value depends on structure that turns mistakes into productive learning moments.
abstract_zh: 大型语言模型（LLMs）能够使辅导更具可扩展性，但前提是学生利用它们来推理错误，而非逃避学习努力。我们通过一项随机实地实验来研究这一问题，实验对象为汉密尔顿县学区超过6000名中学生，使用的是基于研究的计算机辅助学习（CAL）平台NUMI。学生被随机分配到AI辅助与仅CAL支持、掌握进度与非掌握进度，以及两个数学主题之一。一周后，他们完成了一项延迟评估，涵盖已练习和未练习的材料。AI组学生进度较慢，尝试的问题数量较少，但在达到尝试时回答的准确率更高。最明显的机制出现在犯错之后：AI提高了下一次尝试的正确率，并减少了回到正确答案所需的尝试次数，同时增加了在每道题上花费的时间，并获得了结构化支持。掌握进度提高了连续三次答对的达成率，但本身并未改善延迟学习效果。最令人鼓舞的延迟测试证据出现在AI嵌入掌握工作流程时，边际显著性的提升主要集中在已练习的练习1材料上。结果表明，LLM辅导能在标准CAL基础上增加价值，但其价值依赖于将错误转化为有效学习时刻的结构。

title: The bank collateral channel of monetary policy: Evidence from securities losses
title_zh: 货币政策银行抵押品渠道：来自证券损失的证据
title_primary: 货币政策银行抵押品渠道：来自证券损失的证据
title_secondary: The bank collateral channel of monetary policy: Evidence from securities losses
authors: Mariassunta Giannetti, Martina Jasova, Caterina Mendicino, Dominik Supera
official: 官方在线 2026-08-15 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Sharp increases in interest rates can reduce the market value of banks’ securities holdings and threaten financial stability. Using euro area data for 2022-2023, this column shows that such losses can also affect monetary policy transmission through a bank collateral channel: banks with larger losses on collateral-eligible securities obtained less interbank funding and cut lending to firms. This effect was only partially offset for domestic subsidiaries in banking groups. The results demonstrate the importance of collateral values in monetary policy transmission and also emphasise the need for further financial integration across borders.
abstract_zh: 利率急剧上升可能降低银行证券持有的市场价值，并威胁金融稳定。利用2022-2023年欧元区数据，本专栏显示，此类损失还可能通过银行抵押品渠道影响货币政策传导：在符合抵押品条件的证券上损失较大的银行，获得的银行间融资减少，并削减了对企业的贷款。这一效应对于银行集团内的国内子公司仅得到部分抵消。研究结果凸显了抵押品价值在货币政策传导中的重要性，并强调了进一步跨境金融整合的必要性。

title: Bidding wars in the housing market: When directed search becomes stock-flow matching
title_zh: 住房市场中的竞价战：当定向搜索变为存量-流量匹配时
title_primary: 住房市场中的竞价战：当定向搜索变为存量-流量匹配时
title_secondary: Bidding wars in the housing market: When directed search becomes stock-flow matching
authors: Melvyn Coles, Eric Smith
official: 官方在线 2026-08-10 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper considers equilibrium trade in a real estate market. When search is directed, buyers have private independent values, and sellers compete on asking prices, stock-flow matching characterises equilibrium outcomes. Consistent with the data, equilibrium not only generates large and variable price spikes for new listing sales; unsuccessful sellers lower their asking prices over time; and there is equilibrium asking price dispersion. Bidding war data demonstrate that the match surplus is substantial: a lower bound equals 3.3% of house price, whereas ballpark examples suggest match surplus is around 10%.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了房地产市场中的均衡交易。在定向搜索条件下，买方拥有私人独立价值，卖方在要价上竞争，存量-流量匹配刻画了均衡结果。与数据一致，均衡不仅导致新挂牌销售出现大幅且多变的房价飙升；未成功售出的卖方会随时间降低要价；且存在均衡要价离散现象。竞价战数据表明，匹配剩余相当可观：其下限相当于房价的3.3%，而粗略估算示例则显示匹配剩余约为10%。

title: An algorithmic analysis of parallel contests
title_zh: 并行竞赛的算法分析
title_primary: 并行竞赛的算法分析
title_secondary: An algorithmic analysis of parallel contests
authors: Chen Cohen, Ishay Rabi, Aner Sela
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-07 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We consider two-stage parallel contests with a finite set of agents, as well as a finite set of heterogeneous contests with varying winning prizes. In the first stage, each agent simultaneously chooses in which contest he wants to compete, and in the second stage, the agents who chose the same contest compete against each other in a contest for a single prize. We first assume a general Tullock contest success function with nonlinear cost functions, and then we present an algorithm that converges to equilibrium, namely, the algorithm organizes the allocation of homogeneous or heterogeneous agents of two types, each with a different cost of effort, among the contests until no agent wishes to change his current contest. Later, we assume the Tullock contest success function with linear cost functions, and we show that for homogeneous agents, our model and a potential game are equivalent, allowing us to explicitly characterize the subgame perfect equilibrium with pure strategies.
abstract_zh: 我们考虑一个包含有限数量参与者的两阶段并行竞赛模型，以及一系列奖品各异的异质性竞赛。在第一阶段，每位参与者同时选择想要参加的竞赛；在第二阶段，选择同一竞赛的参与者们为争夺单一奖品而相互竞争。我们首先假设采用具有非线性成本函数的通用Tullock竞赛成功函数，随后提出一种收敛至均衡的算法，即该算法组织同质或异质的两类参与者（每类具有不同的努力成本）在竞赛间进行分配，直至没有参与者希望更换其当前竞赛。接着，我们假设采用具有线性成本函数的Tullock竞赛成功函数，并证明对于同质参与者，我们的模型与一个势博弈等价，从而能够明确刻画纯策略下的子博弈完美均衡。

title: 从核准制到注册制：供给冲击、定价扭曲与渐进式改革策略
title_zh: 从核准制到注册制：供给冲击、定价扭曲与渐进式改革策略
title_primary: 从核准制到注册制：供给冲击、定价扭曲与渐进式改革策略
authors: 汲铮, 华生, 傅捷, 张晓奇
official: 官方发布 2026-08-05 · 来源：CNKI RSS
abstract: 股票发行注册制改革作为一项资本市场的关键制度变迁，其改革方向虽清晰在前，但囿于市场承受能力与风险防控约束，该当如何破局、择路径以达目标，亟待研究。鉴于此，本文拓展了异质性投资者模型，通过引入股票供给端因素，构建了一个双异质性动态模型以刻画股票发行制度从核准制到注册制的制度变迁。研究发现，在核准制下，股票发行的供给干预会导致绩优股与绩差股的均衡价格发生错位；倘若直接全面放开股票供给限制至注册制，会造...

title: The European No Net Land Take objective: A meta-challenge
title_zh: 欧洲净零土地占用目标：一项元挑战
title_primary: 欧洲净零土地占用目标：一项元挑战
title_secondary: The European No Net Land Take objective: A meta-challenge
authors: Antoine Decoville, Frédéric Durand
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-05 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: The European objective of achieving “No Net Land Take” (NNLT) by 2050 represents an ambitious paradigm shift in the fields of urban planning and architecture. However, the primary obstacles to its implementation are not technical in nature, but rather stem from our society’s inability to reform itself in order to attain this fundamental goal. This viewpoint paper reviews the political, economic, and sociocultural barriers that must be overcome to effectively halt the loss of agricultural and natural land.
abstract_zh: 欧洲到2050年实现“零净土地占用”（NNLT）的目标，标志着城市规划和建筑领域的一次雄心勃勃的范式转变。然而，其实施的主要障碍并非技术层面，而是源于我们社会在实现这一根本目标上的自我改革能力不足。本文从观点角度审视了必须克服的政治、经济和社会文化障碍，以有效遏制农业和自然土地的流失。

title: Conflicting incentives: How the inevitable disclosure doctrine disparately influences disclosure
title_zh: 冲突激励：不可避免披露原则如何差异化影响信息披露
title_primary: 冲突激励：不可避免披露原则如何差异化影响信息披露
title_secondary: Conflicting incentives: How the inevitable disclosure doctrine disparately influences disclosure
authors: Thomas Bates, Bryan Lim, Jordan Neyland, Yolanda Yulong Wang
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-04 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: The Inevitable Disclosure Doctrine (“IDD”) protects trade secrets and intellectual property but restricts labor mobility by limiting a worker's ability to take jobs at competing firms. Prior literature presents evidence of a causal relationship between the adoption of the IDD and earnings manipulation, as executives have less of a need to demonstrate superior performance to attract and retain employees. At the same time, however, the IDD traps executives in their roles, increasing their personal incentive to manage earnings defensively. We present evidence that executive incentives mitigate the desire to reduce earnings management in firms with lower knowledge-worker turnover after adopting the IDD, suggesting a more nuanced understanding of the relation between labor market mobility and accounting disclosure than has previously been documented.
abstract_zh: 不可避免披露原则（“IDD”）保护商业秘密和知识产权，但通过限制员工在竞争对手处任职的能力，制约了劳动力流动性。既有文献提供了IDD采纳与盈余操纵之间存在因果关系的证据，因为高管在吸引和留住员工方面不再需要展示卓越绩效。然而，与此同时，IDD将高管困于其职位之中，增强了他们防御性管理盈余的个人动机。我们提供的证据表明，在采纳IDD后知识型员工流动率较低的企业中，高管激励缓解了减少盈余管理的意愿，这表明劳动力市场流动性与会计披露之间的关系比以往文献所记载的更为微妙复杂。

title: Prioritizing Benefit? How Low-Income Patients Respond to Prescription Cost-Sharing
title_zh: 优先考虑收益？低收入患者如何应对处方费用分摊
title_primary: 优先考虑收益？低收入患者如何应对处方费用分摊
title_secondary: Prioritizing Benefit? How Low-Income Patients Respond to Prescription Cost-Sharing
authors: Hollrah, Christopher
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper measures how cost-sharing impacts older low-income patients, exploiting a disconti-nuity in eligibility for a prescription drug subsidy for those who lose access to the Medicaid-linked program. Higher drug prices resulting from subsidy loss lead to a 40% reduction in prescription expenditures, driven by a 16% quantity reduction of prescriptions filled. Patients economize on purchases of higher-priced drugs, irrespective of their health benefits. For example, patients re-duce insulin purchases by 35%. There is no evidence that cost-sharing prompts switching from branded drugs to generics. This behavior suggests that cost-sharing reduces prescription accessibility without enhancing cost-effectiveness.
abstract_zh: 本文利用与医疗补助计划挂钩的处方药补贴资格中断现象，测度成本分摊对老年低收入患者的影响。补贴资格丧失导致药价上涨，使处方药支出减少40%，其中处方药配药量下降16%是主要驱动因素。患者会减少高价药品的购买，而不考虑其健康效益。例如，患者将胰岛素购买量减少35%。没有证据表明成本分摊会促使患者从品牌药转向仿制药。这一行为表明，成本分摊在未提升成本效益的情况下，反而降低了处方药的可及性。

title: Trust, business group verticality, and firm productivity
title_zh: 信任、企业集团垂直性与企业生产率
title_primary: 信任、企业集团垂直性与企业生产率
title_secondary: Trust, business group verticality, and firm productivity
authors: Christian Fons‐Rosen, Miriam Manchin, Katalin Szemeredi
official: 官方在线 2026-07-24 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper examines how trust among ultimate owners and their affiliates shapes business group structure and correlates with firm productivity. We first confirm that greater business group verticality is associated with higher firm productivity. We then develop a theoretical model explaining how bilateral trust influences group verticality. To test these predictions, we construct a novel dataset by developing an algorithm that extends Amadeus ownership links into ownership chains, allowing us to measure verticality for a large European sample. We find that groups with higher average trust among members are more vertically structured. Firm-level estimates indicate that more trustworthy affiliates are positioned in a layer closer to the ultimate owner and exhibit higher productivity. Results are robust to using somatic distance as an instrument for bilateral trust.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了最终所有者与其关联方之间的信任如何塑造企业集团结构，并探究其与企业生产率的相关性。我们首先证实，企业集团垂直化程度越高，企业生产率也越高。随后构建理论模型，阐释双边信任如何影响集团垂直化程度。为验证上述预测，我们开发了一种算法，将Amadeus数据库中的所有权链接扩展为所有权链条，据此构建了覆盖欧洲大型样本的新数据集。研究发现，成员间平均信任度更高的集团呈现更显著的垂直结构。企业层面估计表明，可信度更高的关联方更接近最终所有者层级，且表现出更高的生产率。采用体细胞距离作为双边信任的工具变量后，结果依然稳健。

title: Stimulating Avenues: EIB Loans and Returns to Public Investment
title_zh: 激励渠道：欧洲投资银行贷款与公共投资回报
title_primary: 激励渠道：欧洲投资银行贷款与公共投资回报
title_secondary: Stimulating Avenues: EIB Loans and Returns to Public Investment
authors: Ghomi, Morteza, Pappa, Evi
official: 官方在线 2026-07-20 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We study the macroeconomic effects of persistent public investment shocks using a local-projection instrumental-variables framework and European data. For identification we exploit European Investment Bank loans for public infrastructure projects and address potential endogeneity in loan approval with an inverse-probability-weighted regression-adjustment estimator. Public investment shocks raise employment and output in the medium term, without crowding out private investment and consumption, or generating inflation and additional debt burden. The cumulative output multiplier reaches 3.38 after five years and is significant and larger when credit conditions are favorable. We report significant positive spillover effects from spending in public infrastructure in both output and employment.
abstract_zh: 我们利用局部投影工具变量框架和欧洲数据，研究持续性公共投资冲击的宏观经济效应。为识别因果关系，我们采用欧洲投资银行对公共基础设施项目的贷款数据，并通过逆概率加权回归调整估计量解决贷款审批中的潜在内生性问题。公共投资冲击在中期内提升就业与产出，且不会挤出私人投资与消费，亦不会引发通胀或额外债务负担。五年后累计产出乘数达3.38，在信贷条件有利时该乘数显著且更大。我们报告了公共基础设施支出对产出和就业均存在显著的正向溢出效应。

title: What Hundreds of Economic News Events Say About Belief Overreaction in the Stock Market
title_zh: 数百个经济新闻事件揭示的股市信念过度反应现象
title_primary: 数百个经济新闻事件揭示的股市信念过度反应现象
title_secondary: What Hundreds of Economic News Events Say About Belief Overreaction in the Stock Market
authors: Francesco Bianchi, Sydney Ludvigson, Sai MA
official: 官方在线 2024-10-15 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We estimate that investors systematically overreact to perceptions about multiple fundamental shocks in a macro-dynamic system, generating asymmetric compositional effects when real-world events produce conflicting signals with counteracting market implications. We show that such events can lead the market to underreact to news, even when investors overreact to all shocks.
abstract_zh: 我们估计，投资者在宏观动态系统中系统性地过度反应于对多重基本面冲击的感知，当现实事件产生相互冲突的信号并带来抵消性的市场影响时，会引发非对称的构成效应。我们证明，此类事件可能导致市场对新闻反应不足，即便投资者对所有冲击均表现出过度反应。

title: Impacts of contemporaneous air pollution exposure on cognitive performance in Kenya
title_zh: 肯尼亚同期空气污染暴露对认知表现的影响
title_primary: 肯尼亚同期空气污染暴露对认知表现的影响
title_secondary: Impacts of contemporaneous air pollution exposure on cognitive performance in Kenya
authors: Xuqian Ma, Michelle Layvant, Edward Miguel, Eric Ochieng, Ajay Pillarisetti 等
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-15 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We estimate the short-term cognitive effects of fine particulate matter (PM2.5) exposure using novel exposure data collected during cognitive testing in Kenya. Unlike most existing studies that rely on satellite-based or fixed monitoring station data, we measure highly localized ambient pollution using portable monitors deployed at cognitive testing sites and link these readings directly to Harmonized Cognitive Assessment Protocol (HCAP) scores. Higher PM2.5 exposure during testing is associated with lower cognitive performance, particularly in executive function, memory, and visuospatial tasks. Binned exposure models suggest a monotonic pattern, with more negative estimates at higher exposure levels. Notably, effects are significantly larger among more educated individuals, possibly due to greater task demands or lower chronic exposure that limits physiological adaptation. Given that cognitive impairment is evident even at PM2.5 levels below Kenya’s mean annual regulatory threshold of 35 μ g /m 3 , the findings suggest that short-term exposure may impose underappreciated human capital costs that current regulatory standards fail to mitigate. The results highlight the potential cognitive and economic returns to interventions that reduce air pollution exposures in low-resource settings.
abstract_zh: 我们利用在肯尼亚认知测试期间收集的新型暴露数据，估算了细颗粒物（PM2.5）暴露对认知能力的短期影响。与多数依赖卫星或固定监测站数据的现有研究不同，我们在认知测试现场部署便携式监测器，测量高度局地化的环境污染物浓度，并将这些读数直接与协调认知评估协议（HCAP）得分相关联。测试期间较高的PM2.5暴露与较低的认知表现相关，尤其在执行功能、记忆和视觉空间任务中表现显著。分段暴露模型显示单调模式，在较高暴露水平下估计值更为负面。值得注意的是，教育程度较高个体的效应显著更大，这可能归因于更高的任务需求或较低的慢性暴露限制了生理适应。鉴于即使在PM2.5水平低于肯尼亚年均监管阈值35微克/立方米时，认知损伤依然明显，研究结果表明短期暴露可能带来当前监管标准未能缓解的、被低估的人力资本成本。这些结果凸显了在资源匮乏环境中减少空气污染暴露的干预措施可能带来的认知和经济回报。

title: Home Production and Gender Gap in Structural Change
title_zh: 家庭生产与结构变迁中的性别差距
title_primary: 家庭生产与结构变迁中的性别差距
title_secondary: Home Production and Gender Gap in Structural Change
authors: Huoqing Cao, Chaoran Chen, Xican Xi
official: 官方在线 2026-07-08 · 来源：RSS
abstract: The gender gap in non‐agricultural employment in developing countries is concentrated among rural married workers. Within‐family specialization is central: Married women spend more time on home production, work fewer market hours, and are less likely to incur fixed costs of entering non‐agriculture. We develop a general equilibrium Roy model with joint household decisions, sector‐neutral gender labor wedges, and entry barriers. Calibrated to China in 2010, the model reproduces the observed gender employment gap. Gender labor wedges explain about 80% of it, amplified by within‐family specialization, while changing entry barriers account for its widening from 2000 to 2010.
abstract_zh: 摘要 发展中国家非农就业中的性别差距主要集中在农村已婚劳动者群体。家庭内部分工是核心因素：已婚女性在家务劳动上投入更多时间，市场工作时间更少，且更不愿承担进入非农部门所需的固定成本。我们构建了一个包含联合家庭决策、部门中性性别劳动楔子及进入壁垒的一般均衡罗伊模型。基于2010年中国数据的校准结果显示，该模型能够复现观测到的性别就业差距。其中，性别劳动楔子解释了约80%的差距，并通过家庭内部分工机制被放大；而进入壁垒的变化则解释了2000年至2010年间该差距的扩大趋势。

title: Planning Against Disasters in Dynamic Production Networks
title_zh: 动态生产网络中的灾害应对规划
title_primary: 动态生产网络中的灾害应对规划
title_secondary: Planning Against Disasters in Dynamic Production Networks
authors: Vasco Carvalho, Galo Nuño
official: 官方在线 2026-07-08 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: In dynamic multisector economies, the planner’s optimal capital allocation can serve to minimize the aggregate impact of shocks cascading through nonlinear production networks. We show analytically in a simplified model that, under complementarity and if risk aversion is not too low, (i) optimal capital allocation under uncertainty involves deliberately over-investing, relative to the deterministic optimum, in upstream sectors in order to mitigate severe economic downturns; (ii) this strategy can reduce the average level of consumption and give rise to a high welfare cost of business cycles. Deploying novel deep-learning techniques in a general environment, we show quantitatively that: (iii) the ergodic distribution of the simulated nonlinear economy features higher mean capital levels in key upstream sectors, lower mean levels of macroeconomic aggregates, realistic aggregate volatility, and a welfare cost of business cycles two orders of magnitude larger than in standard one-sector models.
abstract_zh: 在动态多部门经济中，规划者的最优资本配置能够最小化通过非线性生产网络级联放大的冲击对总体经济的影响。我们在简化模型中通过解析推导表明，在要素互补性且风险厌恶程度不太低的情况下：（i）不确定性下的最优资本配置策略会相对于确定性最优状态，有意对上游部门进行过度投资，以缓解严重的经济衰退；（ii）该策略可能降低平均消费水平，并导致商业周期产生高昂的福利成本。通过运用新型深度学习技术于一般化环境，我们定量分析发现：（iii）模拟非线性经济的遍历分布呈现关键上游部门平均资本水平更高、宏观经济总量均值更低、总体波动率符合现实特征，且商业周期福利成本比标准单部门模型高出两个数量级。

title: Beyond urban–rural divides: A distributional analysis of spatial inequality in the WAEMU
title_zh: 超越城乡鸿沟：西非经货联盟空间不平等的分布分析
title_primary: 超越城乡鸿沟：西非经货联盟空间不平等的分布分析
title_secondary: Beyond urban–rural divides: A distributional analysis of spatial inequality in the WAEMU
authors: Francis Andrianarison
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-23 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This study re-examines spatial inequality in the West African Economic and Monetary Union (WAEMU) by moving beyond the conventional urban–rural dichotomy and introducing a classification that distinguishes leading and lagging regions within both urban and rural areas. I quantify the contribution of these spatial divides to overall welfare inequality using harmonized household survey data and assess whether spatial gaps reflect differences in endowments or in the returns to those endowments. Combining Theil index decomposition with recentered influence function (RIF) regressions, I show that leading–lagging disparities account for a substantial share of total inequality, frequently exceeding the standard urban–rural divide’s contribution. The differences in returns are particularly pronounced toward the upper end of the welfare distribution, indicating that similar assets yield systematically uneven outcomes across space. These findings show that spatial inequality in WAEMU reflects not only unequal asset distribution but also structurally differentiated returns. Therefore, policies aimed at reducing regional disparities must address access to productive resources and the institutional and market environments shaping their returns. More broadly, this study illustrates how harmonized household surveys combined with distribution-sensitive decomposition methods can uncover the structural dimensions of spatial inequality in developing economies.
abstract_zh: 本研究重新审视了西非经济货币联盟（WAEMU）的空间不平等问题，超越了传统的城乡二元划分，引入了一种区分城市和农村地区内领先区域与滞后区域的分类方法。利用统一的家庭调查数据，我量化了这些空间分割对总体福利不平等的贡献，并评估了空间差距是否反映了禀赋差异或这些禀赋回报率的差异。结合泰尔指数分解与再中心化影响函数（RIF）回归，我表明领先-滞后差距占总不平等的相当大份额，常常超过标准城乡划分的贡献。回报差异在福利分布的上端尤为显著，表明相似的资产在空间上产生了系统性不均的结果。这些发现表明，西非经济货币联盟的空间不平等不仅反映了资产分配的不均，还体现了结构性差异化的回报。因此，旨在缩小区域差距的政策必须同时解决生产性资源的获取以及影响其回报的制度与市场环境。更广泛地说，本研究展示了统一的家庭调查结合对分布敏感的分解方法如何揭示发展中经济体空间不平等的结构维度。

title: Impulse Response Analysis of Structural Nonlinear Time Series Models
title_zh: 结构非线性时间序列模型的脉冲响应分析
title_primary: 结构非线性时间序列模型的脉冲响应分析
title_secondary: Impulse Response Analysis of Structural Nonlinear Time Series Models
authors: Giovanni Ballarin
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-18 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper develops a semiparametric sieve approach to estimate impulse response functions of nonlinear time series models within a broad class of structural autoregressive specifications. A two-step procedure flexibly captures nonlinearities without imposing fixed parametric forms. We establish uniform estimation guarantees and propose an iterative algorithm that makes impulse response computation straightforward. Simulation results show robustness to misspecification with only modest efficiency losses. In an application to U.S. monetary policy, we find larger GDP responses to interest rate hikes than in linear models. We also examine oil supply news shocks of varying magnitudes to assess limitations when analyzing large shocks.
abstract_zh: 本文提出一种半参数筛分方法，用于在广泛的结构自回归模型类别中估计非线性时间序列模型的脉冲响应函数。该两步法无需设定固定参数形式，即可灵活捕捉非线性特征。我们建立了均匀估计保证，并提出一种迭代算法，使脉冲响应计算变得简便。模拟结果表明，该方法对模型误设具有稳健性，且仅带来适度的效率损失。在应用于美国货币政策时，我们发现利率上调对GDP的影响大于线性模型的结果。此外，我们考察了不同幅度的石油供给新闻冲击，以评估分析大规模冲击时的局限性。

title: Two-group, three-period staggered difference-in-differences design and evaluation of labour market effects of minimum wages in China
title_zh: 两组三阶段交错双重差分设计与中国最低工资劳动力市场效应评估
title_primary: 两组三阶段交错双重差分设计与中国最低工资劳动力市场效应评估
title_secondary: Two-group, three-period staggered difference-in-differences design and evaluation of labour market effects of minimum wages in China
authors: Zhengxiong Yang, Mingwei Liu, Shiwei Zhang
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-16 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We examine inference in a two-group, three-period staggered difference-in-differences setting where conventional pre-trends testing is infeasible. By imposing structured assumptions on treatment effect heterogeneity and dynamics, we develop a novel framework that enables reliable inference on the direction of treatment effects while relaxing the parallel-trends assumption. We apply this framework to assess the effects of minimum wages in China, a context in which the validity of existing DiD-based findings may be compromised by the inability to validate pre-trends. The results indicate that minimum wages substantially increase the wages of low-skilled rural migrant workers, with no detectable effects for high-skilled workers. We find no evidence of employment reductions; conversely, the findings suggest a positive employment effect for low-skilled workers.
abstract_zh: 我们考察了一个两组、三期交错双重差分设定中的推断问题，在该设定下，传统的预趋势检验不可行。通过对处理效应异质性和动态性施加结构化假设，我们开发了一个新框架，该框架能够在放宽平行趋势假设的同时，实现对处理效应方向的可靠推断。我们将此框架应用于评估中国最低工资的影响，在这一背景下，现有基于双重差分的研究发现的有效性可能因无法验证预趋势而受到损害。结果表明，最低工资显著提高了低技能农村流动工人的工资，而对高技能工人则未检测到显著效应。我们未发现就业减少的证据；相反，研究结果提示最低工资对低技能工人存在正向就业效应。

title: Time Use and Heterogeneous Markups
title_zh: 时间使用与异质性加成
title_primary: 时间使用与异质性加成
title_secondary: Time Use and Heterogeneous Markups
authors: Brian C. Albrecht, Thomas Phelan, Nick Pretnar
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-13 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We enrich standard models of imperfect competition by allowing consumer demand for market goods to depend non-separably on off-market time. Consumers value final consumption experiences that require both market purchases and time, which reshapes demand elasticities through two opposing forces. First, because time is an input, changes in market prices translate only partially into changes in the cost of an experience and second, households can substitute time for market purchases in response to price variation. We show how these forces alter the mapping from markups to welfare by distinguishing between markups and a holistic counterpart that accounts for the time cost of consumption. In a monopolistically competitive environment with CES preferences over experiences, firm selection and entry is governed solely by the elasticity of substitution between time use and market purchases, and markup dispersion can be consistent with efficiency when time and market purchases are perfect complements. Extending the analysis to oligopolistic competition, we show that forces that raise markups, like greater market concentration and less competitive conduct, also amplify the gap between the usual and holistic markups.
abstract_zh: 我们通过允许市场商品的需求非可分地依赖于非市场时间，来丰富不完全竞争的标准模型。消费者重视需要市场购买和时间投入的最终消费体验，这通过两种相反的力量重塑了需求弹性。首先，由于时间是一种投入，市场价格的变化仅部分转化为体验成本的变化；其次，家庭可以通过时间替代市场购买来应对价格变动。我们展示了这些力量如何通过区分通常的加成率与考虑消费时间成本的全面对应指标，改变加成率向福利的映射关系。在具有CES偏好于体验的垄断竞争环境中，企业选择和市场进入仅由时间使用与市场购买之间的替代弹性决定，并且当时间与市场购买为完全互补时，加成率离散可以与效率一致。将分析扩展到寡头竞争，我们表明提高加成率的力量，如更大的市场集中度和较弱的竞争行为，也会扩大通常加成率与全面加成率之间的差距。

title: Interoperability Between Ad‐Financed Platforms With Endogenous Multi‐Homing
title_zh: 内生多归属下广告融资平台的互操作性
title_primary: 内生多归属下广告融资平台的互操作性
title_secondary: Interoperability Between Ad‐Financed Platforms With Endogenous Multi‐Homing
authors: Marc Bourreau, Adrien Raizonville, Guillaume Thébaudin
official: 官方在线 2026-06-03 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Platform interoperability is considered a powerful tool to promote competition in digital markets when network effects are at play. We study the incentives of two competing ad-funded platforms to provide interoperability in a setting where consumers can single-home or multi-home and decide how much time to spend online. When the platforms are symmetric, perfect interoperability emerges in equilibrium and is socially efficient. When a larger platform has an installed base of customers, its incentive to make its services interoperable is lower than for the smaller platform. Interoperability does not emerge in equilibrium if the installed base is sufficiently large. However, mandating interoperability between the asymmetric platforms is not always socially optimal.
abstract_zh: 平台互操作性被视为在网络效应发挥作用时促进数字市场竞争的有力工具。我们研究了在消费者可以选择单归属或多归属并决定在线时间投入的背景下，两家竞争性广告支持型平台提供互操作性的激励。当平台对称时，完全互操作性在均衡中出现且具有社会效率。当较大平台拥有既定的客户基础时，其提供互操作服务的激励低于较小平台。若既定基础足够大，互操作性不会在均衡中出现。然而，强制不对称平台之间的互操作性并非总是社会最优的。

title: Competition versus coordination: The impact of flattening government on firm creation and aggregate productivity
title_zh: 竞争与协调：政府扁平化对企业创立与全要素生产率的影响
title_primary: 竞争与协调：政府扁平化对企业创立与全要素生产率的影响
title_secondary: Competition versus coordination: The impact of flattening government on firm creation and aggregate productivity
authors: Lingran Yuan, Qizheng Zhang, Binlei Gong
source: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-14 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper studies how flattening government hierarchy shapes firm creation and aggregate productivity. Exploiting the staggered implementation of China’s government reorganization with comprehensive firm registration data, we find that this delayering of government substantially hindered firm creation and reduced aggregate productivity, with effects especially pronounced among larger enterprises. We discuss two primary channels driving this result: weakened coordination arising from expanded provincial control and intensified vertical political competition between prefecture and county governments. Our findings highlight that flattening government hierarchy can generate unintended economic frictions, potentially offsetting its intended benefits.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了政府层级扁平化如何影响企业创立与总体生产率。利用中国政府机构改革的错峰实施及全面的企业注册数据，我们发现这一政府层级精简显著阻碍了企业创立并降低了总体生产率，其中对大型企业的影响尤为突出。我们讨论了两条主要作用机制：省级控制范围扩大导致的协调弱化，以及地级市与县级政府间垂直政治竞争的加剧。我们的研究结果表明，政府层级扁平化可能引发非预期的经济摩擦，从而可能抵消其预期收益。

title: Testing for differences in high-frequency network connectedness from variance decompositions
title_zh: 基于方差分解的高频网络连通性差异检验
title_primary: 基于方差分解的高频网络连通性差异检验
title_secondary: Testing for differences in high-frequency network connectedness from variance decompositions
authors: Mattia Bevilacqua, Michael Ellington, Rodrigo Hizmeri
official: 官方在线 2026-04-03 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We develop a Bayesian Wald-type test for detecting temporal differences in connectedness from variance decompositions, and establish the asymptotic normality of impulse response functions and variance decomposition matrices at fixed local time points. The resulting test statistic is asymptotically χ 2 distributed under the null hypothesis and performs well in Monte Carlo simulations. Applying our methodology to high-frequency options data on sectoral exchange-traded funds (ETFs) from January 2013 to June 2023, we identify and quantify monetary policy surprises following Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) announcements. Our empirical results indicate that total connectedness among sectoral ETF implied volatilities increases significantly following FOMC announcements, with these elevated connectedness levels persisting for approximately one hour on days with monetary policy surprises. Our findings indicate more than one-fifth of FOMC announcements surprise financial markets.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一种贝叶斯Wald型检验，用于检测方差分解中关联性的时间差异，并确立了在固定局部时间点上脉冲响应函数和方差分解矩阵的渐近正态性。所提出的检验统计量在原假设下渐近服从χ²分布，并在蒙特卡洛模拟中表现良好。将我们的方法应用于2013年1月至2023年6月期间行业交易所交易基金（ETFs）的高频期权数据，我们识别并量化了联邦公开市场委员会（FOMC）公告后的货币政策意外。实证结果表明，在FOMC公告后，行业ETF隐含波动率之间的总体关联性显著增强，且这种增强的关联性水平在存在货币政策意外的日子里持续约一小时。我们的发现表明，超过五分之一的FOMC公告令金融市场感到意外。

title: Sinking peatlands: Optimal control of subsidence
title_zh: 沉陷泥炭地：地面沉降的最优控制
title_primary: 沉陷泥炭地：地面沉降的最优控制
title_secondary: Sinking peatlands: Optimal control of subsidence
authors: Suphi Sen, Dewy Verhoeven, Hans‐Peter Weikard
official: 官方在线 2026-04-02 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Land subsidence threatens the living conditions of about 1.2 billion people worldwide in deltaic regions characterized by soft top soil. Economic activity in these areas requires lowering groundwater levels to keep the land sufficiently dry, which leaves future generations worse off by accelerating subsidence and increasing future costs. This paper provides a model that recognizes this trade-off and yields analytical expressions for the groundwater level paths that optimally manage the dynamics of subsidence in agricultural lands. Applying our model to the paradigm case of Dutch peatlands, we find that accounting for dynamic efficiency increases welfare by more than 2.5% compared to a myopic benchmark, and these gains can be about 10% within reasonable parameter ranges. Our results support current proposals to reduce subsidence, even without considering additional social benefits from avoided carbon dioxide emissions.
abstract_zh: 地面沉降威胁着全球约12亿生活在以软质表层土壤为特征的三角洲地区居民的生活条件。这些地区的经济活动需要降低地下水位以保持土地足够干燥，但这会加速沉降并增加未来成本，从而使后代状况恶化。本文提出一个模型，认识到这一权衡，并为农业用地中沉降动态的最优管理提供了地下水位路径的解析表达式。将我们的模型应用于荷兰泥炭地的典型案例，我们发现，与短视基准相比，考虑动态效率可使福利增加超过2.5%，且在合理参数范围内，这些收益可达约10%。我们的结果支持当前减少沉降的提议，即使不考虑避免二氧化碳排放所带来的额外社会效益也是如此。

title: Welfare and spending effects of consumption stimulus policies
title_zh: 消费刺激政策的福利与支出效应
title_primary: 消费刺激政策的福利与支出效应
title_secondary: Welfare and spending effects of consumption stimulus policies
authors: Christopher D. Carroll, Edmund Crawley, William Du, Ivan Frankovic, Håkon Tretvoll
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-01-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Using a heterogeneous agent model calibrated to match spending dynamics over four years following an income shock (Fagereng, Holm, and Natvik (2021)), we assess the effectiveness of three fiscal stimulus policies implemented during recent recessions. Unemployment insurance (UI) extensions are the “bang for the buck” winner when the metric is effectiveness in boosting utility. Stimulus checks are second‐best and have two advantages (over UI): they arrive faster, and are scalable. A temporary (two‐year) cut in wage taxation is considerably less effective than the other policies and has negligible effects in the version of our model without a multiplier.
abstract_zh: 我们利用一个异质性主体模型（该模型根据Fagereng、Holm和Natvik（2021）的收入冲击后四年内的支出动态进行校准），评估了近期经济衰退期间实施的三项财政刺激政策的有效性。以提升效用的有效性为衡量标准时，延长失业保险期限是“性价比”最高的政策。刺激性支票次之，并具有两大优势（相较于失业保险）：发放速度更快且具有可扩展性。临时性（为期两年）的工资税削减政策效果远低于其他两项政策，且在我们模型的无乘数版本中影响微乎其微。

title: Regional disparities in industry-university-research collaboration and economic impact in China: a spatial econometric analysis
title_zh: 中国产学研合作区域差异及其经济影响的空间计量分析
title_primary: 中国产学研合作区域差异及其经济影响的空间计量分析
title_secondary: Regional disparities in industry-university-research collaboration and economic impact in China: a spatial econometric analysis
authors: Jiaqi He Yunyi Luo a Institute of Education, Nanjing University, Nanjing, People’s Republic of Chinab Faculty of Education, East China Normal University, Shanghai, People’s Republic of China
official: 官方在线 2025-07-24 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Amid rising interest in how industry-university-research (IUR) collaboration drives regional development, this study investigates the spatial economic effects of IUR collaboration across 30 Chinese provinces from 2009 to 2019. A coupling coordination index is developed to quantify IUR performance and integrated into a Spatial Durbin Model under three spatial structures: geographic contiguity, physical distance, and economic similarity. Results show that economic similarity generates stronger spatial interdependence than geographic proximity. Nationally, IUR collaboration does not uniformly promote growth and instead produces negative spillovers across neighbouring and structurally similar regions. Subregional analysis reveals clear heterogeneity: eastern provinces benefit from positive spillovers, while central and western provinces exhibit localized impacts, reflecting absorptive constraints and structural gaps. These findings propose a scalable spatial framework for assessing IUR collaboration and offer policy insights for developing countries with uneven innovation capacities.
abstract_zh: 随着产学研合作对区域发展驱动作用日益受到关注，本研究考察了2009年至2019年间中国30个省份产学研合作的空间经济效应。构建耦合协调指数以量化产学研绩效，并将其纳入三种空间结构下的空间杜宾模型：地理邻接、物理距离和经济相似性。结果表明，经济相似性产生的空间相互依赖性强于地理邻近性。在全国层面，产学研合作并未一致促进增长，反而对邻近及结构相似地区产生负向溢出效应。分区域分析揭示了明显的异质性：东部省份受益于正向溢出，而中部和西部省份则表现出局部影响，反映了吸收能力约束和结构性差距。这些发现提出了一个可扩展的产学研合作空间评估框架，并为创新能力不均衡的发展中国家提供了政策启示。
